items.example: A: What's this in English? B: It's a camera.
What are those in your pocket?
Is this your bag? — No, it isn't. It's Sally's.
Are these Jack's glasses? — No, they're Veronika's.
Look, my name's on it. It's mine.
That's my pen. — Oh, sorry, it's yours.

items.translation: Не могли бы вы его открыть?
items.example: Could you open it, please? — What's the problem?
This/These is the problem. Maybe it's Ali's.
What five things are always in your bags?
Take 9/10/11/12 things in your carry-on bag.
